appId.description: AppID of a bot created by hand on q.qq.com, used with the secret QQ_APP_SECRET. Not needed after a QR sign-in, which brings its own.

groups.description: Deliver group messages that mention the bot and let the assistant answer in the group (qq_group_reply). Off: they are stored, not delivered.

stopWords.description: Owner messages equal to one of these interrupt the current turn.

apiBase.description: QQ Open Platform API base URL (for tests).

bindBase.description: QR sign-in service base URL (for tests).
